chart.title: Women who make informed decisions regarding their sexual relations, contraceptive use and reproductive health care
chart.subtitle: Women aged 15-49 (married or in union) who can say no to sexual intercourse with their husband or partner if they do not want, decide on use of contraception, and decide on their own health care.
chart.note: Based on the Demographic and Health Surveys, Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys and other national surveys.
selection: Northern Africa and Western Asia (UN SDG)
Latin America and the Caribbean (UN SDG)
